    # A neutral or allied handover is not enemy occupation. No reward.
    clr_state_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_away
    clr_state_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_grace
    clr_state_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_prolonged
    add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_recovery days = 7 }
    PRS = { if = { limit = { exists = PRS is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown } NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_thirdparty_seen } }
   set_country_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_thirdparty_seen
   set_country_flag = { flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown days = 30 }
   country_event = { id = sof_vp.216 }
  } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = { limit = { has_state_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_away NOT = { has_state_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_grace } NOT = { has_state_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_prolonged } NOT = { PRS = { controls_province = 10776 } } }
  set_state_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_prolonged
  remove_dynamic_modifier = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_disrupted
  add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_entrenched }
  PRS = { if = { limit = { exists = PRS is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown } NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_extended_seen } }
   set_country_flag = sof_vp_paris_prefecture_extended_seen
   set_country_flag = { flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown days = 30 }
   country_event = { id = sof_vp.213 }
  } }
 }
}

sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_check = {
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_initialized } }
  every_country = { limit = { controls_province = 3425 } set_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_holder }
  set_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_initialized
 }
 else_if = { limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_holder controls_province = 3425 } } }
  every_possible_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_holder } clr_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_holder }
  every_country = { limit = { controls_province = 3425 } set_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_holder }
  # Ignore non-hostile administrative transfers until this node has seen an actual war.
  if = { limit = { OR = { has_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_war any_country = { controls_province = 3425 has_war_with = AJC } } }
   set_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_war
   remove_dynamic_modifier = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_entrenched
   remove_dynamic_modifier = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_recovery
   remove_dynamic_modifier = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_disrupted
   if = { limit = { AJC = { controls_province = 3425 } }
    clr_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_away
    clr_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_grace
    clr_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_prolonged
    add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_recovery days = 7 }
    AJC = { if = { limit = { exists = AJC is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown } NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_recapture_seen } }
   set_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_recapture_seen
   set_country_flag = { flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown days = 30 }
   country_event = { id = sof_vp.222 }
  } }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { any_country = { controls_province = 3425 has_war_with = AJC } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_lost_once } }
     set_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_lost_once
     AJC = { if = { limit = { exists = AJC is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown } NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_loss_seen } }
   set_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_loss_seen
   set_country_flag = { flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown days = 30 }
   country_event = { id = sof_vp.221 }
  } }
    }
    else = {
     AJC = { if = { limit = { exists = AJC is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown } NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_repeat_seen } }
   set_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_repeat_seen
   set_country_flag = { flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown days = 30 }
   country_event = { id = sof_vp.224 }
  } }
    }
    set_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_away
    set_state_flag = { flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_grace days = 21 }
    clr_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_prolonged
    add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_disrupted days = 7 }
    every_country = { limit = { controls_province = 3425 NOT = { tag = AJC } }
     if = { limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown } NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_capture_seen } }
      set_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_capture_seen
      set_country_flag = { flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown days = 30 }
      country_event = { id = sof_vp.225 }
     }
    }
   }
   else = {
    # A neutral or allied handover is not enemy occupation. No reward.
    clr_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_away
    clr_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_grace
    clr_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_prolonged
    add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_recovery days = 7 }
    AJC = { if = { limit = { exists = AJC is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown } NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_thirdparty_seen } }
   set_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_thirdparty_seen
   set_country_flag = { flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown days = 30 }
   country_event = { id = sof_vp.226 }
  } }
   }
  }
 }
 if = { limit = { has_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_away NOT = { has_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_grace } NOT = { has_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_prolonged } NOT = { AJC = { controls_province = 3425 } } }
  set_state_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_prolonged
  remove_dynamic_modifier = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_disrupted
  add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_entrenched }
  AJC = { if = { limit = { exists = AJC is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown } NOT = { has_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_extended_seen } }
   set_country_flag = sof_vp_corte_mountain_rail_extended_seen
   set_country_flag = { flag = sof_vp_notice_cooldown days = 30 }
   country_event = { id = sof_vp.223 }
  } }
 }
}
